# Informational pages 02: User profile (General admin)

Deactivate asks for confirmation and warns about the roles nobody else holds; after it the status changes and the action becomes Activate. Reset password marks the user as “Must change password”. Every action is added to the account log and announced in the status region under the header.

A complete standalone component built only from `@mod-internal/ui`, Angular and plain CSS with the library tokens. Copy it, rename the selector and class, replace the sample text and data with the project's own (and its translation mechanism), and keep the structure.

```ts

  protected setActive(active: boolean): void {

    this.say('Saved');
  }

  private log(heading: string, tone: ModTimelineTone, icon: string): void {
    this.events.update((events) => [
      { id: events.length + 1, heading, time: 'Now', actor: 'Saad Al-Mutairi · General admin', tone, icon },
      ...events,
    ]);
  }

  /** Shows a message in the status region and clears it after a while. */
```
